description: This line plot illustrates the training loss over training steps for six different transformer-based models fine-tuned on a 20 million data point chemical dataset. The x-axis represents the training step, labeled “Step,” and is plotted on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 440K, with major tick marks at intervals of 100K. The y-axis represents the training loss, labeled “Train Loss,” and is plotted on a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 0.85, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.25. The plot contains six colored lines, each corresponding to a specific model configuration as indicated in the legend: a red line for ChemBART Small 20M, a blue line for ChemBART Medium 20M, a green line for ChemBERTa Small 20M, an orange line for ChemBERTa Medium 20M, a purple line for ChemLLaMA Small 20M, and a brown line for ChemLLaMA Medium 20M. All lines begin at a high training loss near 0.75 at step 0 and exhibit a rapid decline in loss during the initial training steps. The loss then plateaus at a low value, approximately between 0.2 and 0.3, after around 60K steps. The lines show some fluctuation around this plateau, with the green (ChemBERTa Medium 20M) and purple (ChemLLaMA Small 20M) lines appearing to converge at the lowest loss values near 0.25. The brown (ChemLLaMA Medium 20M) and blue (ChemBART Medium 20M) lines also converge near the lowest loss values, slightly above 0.25. The red (ChemBART Small 20M) and orange (ChemBERTa Small 20M) lines show slightly higher loss values at the plateau, hovering around 0.3.
